theorem lemma_5_1_1_term {y z : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hz : 0 < z) {r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
    (hr₁ : r₁ ∈ Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊) (hr₂ : r₂ ∈ Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊) :
    |if Nat.Coprime r₁ r₂ ∧ Odd (r₁ * r₂) then
        (μ r₁ : ℝ) * μ r₂ * (cntSq (2 * (r₁ * r₂)) (aL y z r₁ r₂) (bL z r₁ r₂) -
          4 * z / π ^ 2 / ((σ 1 r₁ : ℝ) * σ 1 r₂) * wM y r₁ r₂) else 0| ≤
      1.27 * √z * (1 + 1 / √2) * ((if Odd r₁ then divA r₁ else 0) *
        (if Odd r₂ then divA r₂ else 0)) :=

note: Lean keeps (r₁,r₂) fixed, with no s_i = r_i/d_i reindexing here (it reappears only in sum_odd_divisors_le). The book's split 'truncated main (5.13) + error (5.14)', then 'completed (5.15) − tail (5.16)', becomes a single per-m comparison bounded by the fsq summand.
